piezas.titular: Three passes. Nobody asked to see them.

clips.escena: Medium close shot of a welder at a steel workbench in a small Puerto Rico fabrication shop, TIG welding a butt joint between two thick steel plates. Welding helmet DOWN, face not visible, worn leather jacket, leather TIG gloves. One gloved hand holds a real industrial water-cooled TIG torch with a black rubber torch body, a pink-white ceramic alumina cup and a short tungsten electrode, with its gas hose and power cable running back out of frame to the welding machine; the other feeds a thin silver filler rod into the joint. The arc is a small intense white point at the joint, no sparks.
clips.movimiento: Realistic documentary footage continuing this exact photo. The torch travels very slowly and steadily along the joint while the filler rod dips in and out in a small, regular rhythm. The arc flickers naturally, faint smoke rises. Static camera with a very slow push-in. No sudden movements. Ambient hiss of the TIG arc.

clips.escena: Close-up of the same welding: two gloved hands, a real industrial water-cooled TIG torch with a black rubber torch body, a pink-white ceramic alumina cup and a short tungsten electrode, with its gas hose and power cable running back out of frame to the welding machine angled over a steel plate joint with a fresh shiny weld bead forming behind the cup, a thin filler rod entering the puddle. Small white arc, no sparks, background dark and out of focus.
clips.movimiento: Realistic macro footage continuing this exact photo. The torch moves a few centimeters slowly along the joint, the bead grows behind it, the filler rod dabs the puddle steadily. Camera static. No new objects. Ambient arc hiss.

clips.escena: Close-up of a finished multi-pass weld on a steel plate butt joint, still slightly warm, heat tint colors on the metal, resting on a steel bench. A gloved hand rests beside it. No torch in frame, no arc, no spark, no glow. Soft side light from a shop door.
clips.movimiento: Realistic documentary footage continuing this exact photo. Very slow camera push-in along the weld. The gloved thumb slowly runs along the bead once. Nothing else moves. Quiet shop ambience.
